function.name: reelix_delete_file
function.description: Delete an uploaded Reelix file and terminate its direct download link. Only the user who uploaded the file can delete it (the file is looked up by the caller's chat id, so other users cannot remove it). Use this when the user asks to delete or remove a specific uploaded Reelix download file, for example 'delete that file' or 'remove the download link'. The fileId is the id returned when the file was uploaded (reelix_movies download with upload=true).

fileId.description: The id of the uploaded Reelix file to delete, as returned by the download/upload call.
